questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that traffic is merging from the right. Slow down and be ready to allow the merging traffic to safely join your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm with index finger extended, it signals the group to form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the road ahead is now divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to a school zone ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one lane. You need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use the lane it shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A hand signal with your left arm extended straight out means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: An upcoming bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a sharp turn is coming. You should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop completely before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other traffic pass. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane ends and becomes a ramp. If you stay in that lane, you must exit. You can change lanes if you want to continue on the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest legal speed for the road. In rain, snow, ice, or other bad conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.
